close_reason: Added test resolve_args_wildcard_over_flat_string_array covering path='/ids/*' over flat string array per Fastmail sample pattern.
description: Fastmail's official JMAP samples (top-ten.py) use path '/ids/*' in Email/get result references — not just '/ids'. This is valid RFC 8620 §3.7 wildcard usage: the * maps over each string element in /ids and returns the same flat array. Our wildcard implementation in json_pointer_ext should handle this, but we have no test coverage for the case where * is the final token and the source is a flat string array (not an object). Add a test to resolve_args or json_pointer_ext covering: prior response has ids:["a","b","c"], path='/ids/*', result must equal ["a","b","c"].
title: jmap-server: add test for /ids/* result reference path
